title: Additive Leray comparison natural under coefficient endomorphisms
statement: Let $p:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with injective resolutions in the category of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $F$ be a module sheaf on $Y$, and suppose $R^n p_*F=0$ for every $n>0$. For every $q\geq0$, there is an additive equivalence $e:H^q(X,p_*F)\simeq H^q(Y,F)$ [pqf-def-cohomology] such that for every module endomorphism $\varphi:F\to F$ and every $x\in H^q(X,p_*F)$, $e(H^q(p_*\varphi)(x))=H^q(\varphi)(e(x))$. No scheme below $X$, restricted scalar action, or scalar-linearity assertion occurs in this statement.

proof.text: Take an injective module resolution. Forgetting module coefficients is exact. Its terms are flasque abelian sheaves; sections of a short exact sequence beginning in a flasque sheaf are surjective on every open, and quotients of two flasque sheaves are flasque. The direct-image acyclicity criterion makes these terms direct-image acyclic. Acyclic resolutions compute abelian higher direct images, while the module resolution computes module higher direct images; forgetting commutes with direct image and homology. Hence positive module-image vanishing implies positive abelian-image vanishing.
Apply the natural topological Leray edge to the underlying abelian sheaf. Positive higher direct images vanish by the preceding step, so the edge is an isomorphism in every degree.

The sheafified free abelian representable at the terminal open is the constant integer sheaf: each open has exactly one map to the terminal open. Precomposition with this actual source isomorphism identifies terminal Ext cohomology with the ordinary H definition. Associativity of Ext composition proves its coefficient naturality. Compose both source-model identifications with the natural Leray edge; its naturality for every coefficient endomorphism is the displayed equation.

proof_origin.note: The additive/naturality part of the original two-step Leray plan; the scalar promotion is proved in the parent module.

theorem exists_addEquiv_H_pushforward_natural_of_higherDirectImage_vanishing
    {Y X : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ X) [HasInjectiveResolutions Y.Modules]
    (F : Y.Modules)
    (hF : ∀ q : ℕ, 0 < q → IsZero ((higherDirectImage p q).obj F)) (q : ℕ) :
    ∃ e : ((pushforward p).obj F).H q ≃+ F.H q,
      ∀ (φ : F ⟶ F) (x : ((pushforward p).obj F).H q),
        e (H.map ((pushforward p).map φ) q x) = H.map φ q (e x)
